explicit_propositions.text: Joe Walsh was born in North Barrington, Illinois.
Joe Walsh is the fifth of nine children.
Joe Walsh earned a BA in English from Grinnell College.
Joe Walsh holds a Master's degree in Public Policy from the University of Chicago.
Joe Walsh taught American government and American history at Hebrew Technology College and Open Community College in Chicago.
Joe Walsh was elected to the U.S. Congress in 2010.
Joe Walsh refused congressional health benefits and pension.
Joe Walsh slept in his office during his time in Congress.
Joe Walsh supported the Balanced Budget Amendment and term limits.
Joe Walsh opposed tax increases and advocated for cutting pay for members of Congress if the budget wasn't passed.
